cases.name: Juanita Rosario
cases.about: "Juanita Rosario lived a life of kindness and compassion, “always more worried about other people than herself," her daughter said. Julie Rosario, 40, of California, said her mother raised her and her brother and previously worked making eyeglasses, before retiring. “She was an awesome mom. Very hardworking, very smart, and very kind,” she said of her mother." https://www.nj.com/camden/2019/08/accused-killer-suffocated-compassionate-74-year-woman-who-gave-him-place-to-stay-family-says.html
